answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a unique stake-weighted vertex in a permissionless auction graph, so a new entrant must post a macro-prudential liquidity buffer before bidding. Colluders attempting to forge duplicate identities on any knoll of that graph are detected via correlated stake fingerprints and lose their multi-unit auction allocations. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
